us.label: US News
us.subtitle: Top domestic stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: US Senate passes $70 billion ICE funding package
bullets: The Senate passed a large funding measure for Immigration and Customs Enforcement.
The package drew attention because a proposed restriction on Trump’s “anti-weaponization” fund failed.
The story was carried by CNBC and discussed in political-news forums within the past day.

articles.title: Trump administration and Iran tensions dominate Washington agenda
bullets: A 60-day US-Iran memorandum was set to expire Monday with no permanent deal announced.
Trump reiterated that Iran cannot have a nuclear weapon “in any way, shape, or form.”
The Independent reported continuing diplomatic friction over the Strait of Hormuz.

articles.title: Trump orders reduced US-South Korea military exercises
bullets: NBC News reported Trump directed the Pentagon to scale down joint drills with South Korea.
Trump cited Seoul’s refusal to join the Iran war and his relationship with North Korea’s Kim Jong Un.
The move sparked concern about US security commitments in East Asia.

articles.title: Sellers pull homes off the market at fastest pace since 2020
bullets: CNBC reported a sharp increase in home listings being withdrawn from the market.
The trend reflects pressure from high prices, affordability constraints and a slower housing market.
The report was among CNBC’s most-discussed US economy stories.

articles.title: Long-term unemployment rises in the US
bullets: CNBC reported the number of Americans unemployed for at least 27 weeks has climbed above 1.8 million on average this year.
The report highlighted costs for both workers and the broader economy.
The labor-market story circulated widely in economics forums within the past day.

global.label: Global
global.subtitle: Top worldwide stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: EU plans far-reaching Russia sanctions package for autumn
bullets: Reuters reported the EU is preparing a broad sanctions package against Russia.
The plan was described by the EU foreign-policy chief as among the bloc’s most far-reaching measures.
The package is expected to be developed in the autumn.

articles.title: Iran-US tensions keep Strait of Hormuz in focus
bullets: The Independent reported the US-Iran ceasefire memorandum was expiring Monday.
Shipping through the Strait of Hormuz remained disrupted amid competing US and Iranian positions.
Oil-market pressure continued as talks failed to deliver a permanent settlement.

articles.title: UK-made drones strike targets inside Russia
bullets: A BBC-linked report said UK-made drones had struck targets inside Russia.
The story drew heavy discussion as Ukraine’s long-range strike campaign continues.
The report was circulated in world-news forums on August 16–17.

articles.title: Finland’s president says EU should expand to 40 states, including Canada
bullets: CNBC reported comments from Finland’s president about a much larger European Union.
The proposal included Canada as a potential member in a broader geopolitical vision.
The story circulated widely in European-news discussions.

articles.title: Red Sea and Hormuz chokepoints raise oil-market vulnerability concerns
bullets: CNBC reported that Iranian threats against maritime chokepoints are heightening energy-security risks.
Analysts focused on the Red Sea and Strait of Hormuz as pressure points for global oil flows.
The issue remained tied to the broader Iran conflict and shipping disruptions.

india.label: India News
india.subtitle: Top India stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Delhi SIR process extended; draft electoral rolls moved to August 17
bullets: The Election Commission extended Delhi’s Special Intensive Revision schedule.
Ground News summarized reporting that draft rolls were moved to August 17 and final rolls to October 19.
The revised schedule extends house-to-house verification by Booth Level Officers.
articles.source: Ground News / Hindustan Times / Indian Express

articles.title: Maharashtra electoral-roll verification deadline extended after heavy rains
bullets: The Indian Express reported the Election Commission extended Maharashtra’s SIR verification deadline.
Officials cited disruption from heavy rainfall during the first phase of the exercise.
Claims and objections were rescheduled to run from August 17 to September 16.

articles.title: India arrests more than 200 people in multi-state crackdown on alleged ISI-backed network
bullets: Indian security agencies reported arrests across 14 states in a crackdown on the Shahzad Bhatti Network.
Officials said recoveries included IEDs, grenades, pistols, live cartridges and surveillance equipment.
The Home Minister described the operation as part of India’s zero-tolerance approach to terrorism.
articles.source: Amit Shah / Sidhant Sibal on X

articles.title: India EV exports jump sharply, social-media data points to 16-fold rise
bullets: A widely shared India export update said EV exports rose from $22 million to $369 million in a year.
The figure was circulated by REDBOXINDIA and discussed in India-focused forums.
The jump was framed as part of India’s broader manufacturing-export push.

articles.title: India hockey schedule highlights August 17 England match
bullets: The Indian Express reported India’s hockey campaign schedule includes an August 17 match against England.
India were also drawn to face Wales and Pakistan in the same group-stage stretch.
The Pakistan match was described as a high-voltage fixture.

stocks.label: US Stocks
stocks.subtitle: Top US stock-market movers and market stories

articles.title: Meta shares sink on report of massive AI funding push
bullets: CNBC reported Meta’s stock fell after a report that the company may raise tens of billions of dollars for AI.
The story focused on investor concern about the scale of AI capital spending.
Meta remained one of the most-discussed technology movers.

articles.title: Big investors hunt for next AI winners as capex concerns ease
bullets: Reuters reported major investors are looking beyond the largest AI names for future winners.
The story said some anxiety about AI capital expenditure has faded.
The theme remained central to US equity-market rotation.

articles.title: Marvell Technology and Flex to join S&P 500
bullets: CNBC reported Marvell Technology and Flex will be added to the S&P 500 index.
The companies are replacing Pool and Campbell’s in the benchmark.
Index additions often trigger buying from funds that track the S&P 500.

articles.title: SpaceX blocked from early US benchmark-index entry
bullets: CNBC reported S&P reaffirmed existing rules that blocked SpaceX from early index entry.
The decision was watched because of intense investor interest in private-space exposure.
The story affected sentiment around space and AI-infrastructure names.

articles.title: Chevron CEO warns oil-supply shortages will begin appearing
bullets: Reuters reported Chevron’s CEO said oil-supply shortages are expected to emerge.
Energy shares were watched as oil-market risks stayed elevated.
The story came amid geopolitical pressure on shipping and crude supply.

articles.title: Trump administration and OpenAI discuss possible government stake
bullets: CNBC reported the US administration discussed a possible government stake in OpenAI.
The talks put AI policy, national strategy and private-company ownership in focus.
The story was one of CNBC’s most-circulated business items.

articles.title: Google to pay SpaceX for compute capacity at xAI data centers
bullets: CNBC reported Google would pay SpaceX $920 million a month for compute capacity.
The arrangement involves xAI data centers and large-scale AI infrastructure demand.
The report highlighted the growing cost of AI compute.

articles.title: Amazon unveils latest warehouse robot amid AI layoffs
bullets: CNBC reported Amazon introduced a new warehouse robot.
The launch came as tech companies continue restructuring workforces around AI.
The story underscored automation’s growing role in logistics.

articles.title: AstraZeneca CEO says AI is reshaping drug development
bullets: CNBC reported AstraZeneca’s CEO said AI is improving drug-development work.
The company said AI can help boost odds of success in research pipelines.
The story connects AI investment with pharmaceutical productivity.

articles.title: Housing sellers withdraw listings at fastest pace since 2020
bullets: CNBC reported sellers are pulling homes off the market quickly.
The move reflects a mismatch between seller expectations and buyer affordability.
Housing remained a major business and consumer-finance story.

articles.title: OpenAI and US officials discuss possible government stake
bullets: CNBC reported discussions about a possible US government stake in OpenAI.
The report raised questions about state involvement in strategic AI companies.
OpenAI remained central to AI policy and investment debates.

articles.title: Google-SpaceX compute deal highlights AI infrastructure boom
bullets: CNBC reported Google would pay SpaceX for large-scale compute capacity at xAI data centers.
The deal shows how hyperscalers and AI firms are competing for processing power.
AI infrastructure remains a major driver of tech-sector capital spending.

articles.title: Bluesky looks to Reddit for inspiration after slower growth
bullets: CNBC reported Bluesky is studying Reddit-style features as it tries to grow.
The platform launched as a Twitter rival but remains far less popular.
The strategy reflects ongoing competition among social-media platforms.

articles.title: Amazon’s new robot spotlights warehouse automation
bullets: CNBC reported Amazon unveiled a new warehouse robot.
The launch comes as AI and robotics reshape logistics operations.
Automation remains a core Amazon investment area.

articles.title: AI increasingly used in pharmaceutical research, AstraZeneca says
bullets: CNBC reported AstraZeneca’s CEO said AI is changing drug development.
The company said AI tools may improve the probability of research success.
The story shows AI moving beyond software into life-sciences workflows.
